name: MAC-Splat
definition: A training framework for sparse-view 3D reconstruction that uses direct 3D consistency supervision to resolve depth and correspondence ambiguities. It builds on the MASt3R geometric backbone and a frozen DINOv3 encoder to obtain semantically informed 2D correspondences, which serve as geometric anchors for 3D supervision.
summary: MAC-Splat is a sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that resolves depth ambiguities by enforcing direct 3D consistency on matched Gaussians using semantically informed correspondences.
